fact: On 28 March 2024 Airtel Money and MTN MoMo, as payment institutions (établissements de paiement), signed the statutes of the APEP at the Ministry of Economy and Finance, which now supervises them in place of the telecoms ministry.
title: Création de l'Association professionnelle des établissements de paiement (APEP)
publisher: Ministère de l'économie et des finances (Cellule de communication)
